Backend Engineer, Bengaluru. You will design and build services in Python, work with PostgreSQL and Redis, and deploy on AWS using Docker and Kubernetes. We expect solid knowledge of REST API design, microservices, testing, and CI/CD. Experience with Kafka or other message queues is a plus. You will review code, write clear documentation, and take part in on-call rotation. Strong communication and a habit of measuring performance are important. We run agile sprints, value ownership, and ship small changes often. Experience with Django or FastAPI, observability tools and cloud cost awareness will help you succeed in this role from the first week.
